summary: Iter 85 — Sci-Fi cockpit /missions UX upgrade verified end-to-end via Playwright. Countdown 3→2→1→LOS!, prompt-block hide/show transitions, BigRecordButton/BigStopButton/BigTimer/PromptPill, cancel-disabled states, and localStorage TTS-speed persistence all work. VoiceSpeedToggle is wired into AnalysisResults beside Wlad assessment (verified via code review since the live analysis pipeline is slow/optional).
action_items: Optional: request mentioned test@test.com is admin with /missions access — in this env, test@test.com is treated as free-tier and hits VideoUpsellModal. Used accelerator@wladbot.test (PLUS tier) instead. If test@test.com should bypass paywall as admin, verify backend ADMIN_EMAILS env / role assignment.

Optional UX: during countdown the recording video stream is not yet acquired (mic icon visible in setup state). On real device, getUserMedia is only invoked after countdown completes — if camera permission is denied at that moment, user will see a hard fail. Consider acquiring stream during countdown so permission prompt happens up-front.
critical_code_review_comments: RecordingCountdown effect dependency only on [n, onComplete]; works because handleCountdownComplete is wrapped in useCallback in parent. Acceptable.

VoicePlayButton correctly applies audio.playbackRate = getTtsSpeed() at instantiation AND subscribes to 'wladbot:tts-speed' for live updates — properly cleans up listener on onended/onerror. Looks good.
ttsSpeed.js gracefully handles localStorage absence (try/catch) and rejects unknown values (falls back to DEFAULT 1.25). Solid.
RecordingStudio: BigStopButton uses red palette (red-500) — confirmed acceptable as 'stop is destructive' is standard pattern; only the START button was required to be lime per spec, which it is.
test_credentials: accelerator@wladbot.test / test123 used because test@test.com is free-tier in this env and gets blocked by VideoUpsellModal as expected per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 85 frontend flow verified live: studio→record→countdown(3,2,1,LOS!)→recording(timer+pill)→stop→post-actions. prompt-block correctly absent during counting AND recording states. cancel-video-btn correctly disabled in both states. localStorage key wladbot_tts_speed_v1 persists across reload. VoiceSpeedToggle import + placement in AnalysisResults.js:93 confirmed via code grep beside Wlad assessment + VoicePlayButton. Test user accelerator@wladbot.test (PLUS) needed; test@test.com falls into upsell modal. Login on this env can hit 429 rate-limit briefly after multiple attempts — wait ~30s between login attempts.
